titre: [$175] Search - Decide how selected people filters behave when switching workspaces
corps:
## Summary Decide how Search should handle selected people who have no reports in a newly selected workspace. This is a follow-up to [Look up personal details on server in UserSelector](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/104303). In the [product decision requesting this follow-up](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/104303#issuecomment-7137481458), `heyjennahay` confirmed that the PR can proceed without changing the existing behavior and that an active filter should not simply be hidden. ## Reproduction scenario Preconditions: - User A is an admin of Workspace X and Workspace Y. - Member B submitted reports in Workspace X and was subsequently removed from that workspace. - Member B was never a member of Workspace Y and has no reports there. 1. As User A, go to Reports (Search). 2. Open Filters > Workspace and select Workspace X. 3. Open From, search for Member B, and select them. 4. Change the Workspace filter to Workspace Y. 5. Open From again. **Current behavior reported in the PR:** Member B remains visible and selected, although they have no reports in Workspace Y, resulting in empty search results. This is an existing selected-filter behavior, not a newly suggested person for Workspace Y. ## Scope and considerations - Decide the intended UX when a workspace change makes an existing people selection irrelevant. - Do not merely hide an active selection: users must be able to understand and remove filters affecting their results. - Automatically clearing inapplicable selections was suggested, but has **not** been agreed as the solution. If chosen, validate against the new workspace's server results before removing selections so former members who do have reports there are retained. - Confirm whether the decision should apply consistently to From, To, Paid by, Assignee, and Attendee. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Agree and document the product/design behavior for selected people with no reports in the newly selected workspace. - [ ] Implement the agreed behavior in the applicable people filters. - [ ] Verify the workspace-switch scenario above and ensure active filters cannot become hidden and impossible to remove. - [ ] Verify selected current/former members who do have reports in the destination workspace are handled correctly, including while the server lookup is pending. - [ ] Add regression coverage for the agreed behavior. ## References - [Reviewer context and follow-up rationale](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/104303#issuecomment-6939591070) - [Product approval to track this separately](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/104303#issuecomment-7137481458)
